tool_input.description: Final data verification for all 3 canonical models
tool_input.sql:
SELECT 'can_client' as model, count(*) as total_rows, count(distinct client_id) as distinct_keys
FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_CANONICAL.CAN_CLIENT
UNION ALL
SELECT 'can_advisor', count(*), count(distinct advisor_id)
FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_CANONICAL.CAN_ADVISOR
UNION ALL
SELECT 'can_account_value', count(*), count(distinct financial_account_id)
FROM KEVANS_WH_RIA_AI_READY.SILVER_CANONICAL.CAN_ACCOUNT_VALUE
